searchText: question to EL clients, is there any clients that support a PoS genesis block? In case the answer is no, are there any plans to support that? What do you mean a PoS genesis block? Besu can start from a merged genesis and I think most if not all ELs can now. My understanding is that we currently start from a PoW genesis block for some testnets which has a minimal difficulty but non zero difficulty (0x1), TTD being used as 0 would mean that this block triggers the PoS consensus mechanism and block 1 will be now validated using the PoS mechanisms, is that correct? ah right, yes I think besu currently needs the genesis block to have a non-zero difficulty (though I don't know why). I'm not sure about other clients. As far as the CL layer is concerned that's still a PoS block and it's payload can be embedded in the CL genesis. Are there any obvious issues with this selfdestruct deactivation method? https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/6155
